# `ew recover`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from bin/ew/api/cli.json and bin/ew/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

1 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew recover`

```text
ew recover [--project <project>] [--replay] [--discard] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--replay` | no | no |
| `--discard` | no | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | summarised, replayed and saved, discarded, or no journal |
| 1 | the replay refused or the discard not confirmed |
| 2 | usage, no controlling terminal, lock, open and save errors |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.recover-result/1`, schema [`ew.recover-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.recover-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.recover-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `action` | [`RecoverAction`](#recoveraction) | yes |  | What ran: `summary` (no flag) or `replay` (`--replay`). |
| `generation` | integer (format `uint64`, min 0) | yes |  | The generation on disk afterwards. |
| `journal` | [`JournalSummary`](#journalsummary) or `null` | no |  | The journal of the newest crashed session; `null` when there is none. |
| `replayed` | boolean | yes |  | Whether its transactions were replayed and saved. |

### JournalSummary

The summary of a crashed session's journal.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_matches` | boolean | yes |  | Whether the project on disk is still the journal's base (the replay cannot collide). |
| `further` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | How many further crashed sessions' journals remain after this one (each is offered by its own `ew recover`). |
| `labels` | array of string | yes |  | The command of each transaction, in journal order. |
| `transactions` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | Its unsaved transactions. |

### RecoverAction

What `ew recover` did.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"summary"` | The summary only. |
| `"replay"` | The replay and save. |
